response.justification: Highly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience that maps precisely to a hard-to-find requirement. Strong engineering craft signals: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored his own test runner and assertion library, and a track record of teaching and public speaking. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright named) and Kotlin/Java exposure is dated, but these are learnable for an engineer of this depth. Frontend depth is somewhat Ember-weighted with less demonstrated React breadth.
strengths: Deep TS/Node + React/Mongo/AWS full-stack track record
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience (rare, directly requested)
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship credentials (TDD, built test frameworks)
